about: How the coin left in a deep site's room lies there, and how the place looks once it is gathered: one pair drawn for each room by its own id (see src/world/deep/deep-rooms.ts; the play-structure investigation's PT-15). Add a pair to add a way; nothing in the engine needs to change.
left_about: What an earlier party left at the camp where they turned back (or did not), a deep site's special room: one thing drawn from each of these, as Orsino's shop of that kind would sell it (data/generation/scenes/orsino-world.json#shops), the first always and each after it one time in two. A party setting out against the worst carried a wand or a ring of minor protection, and a scroll or a draught.
_carried_about: How the coin a band of newcomers carried lies where they fell (src/world/deep/deep-carried.ts): one pair drawn for each band by its own id, as the hoards are.
carried: Coins lie among the fallen, spilled from a pouch one of them wore.
Nothing is left among the fallen but what they wore.
A greasy sack lies where they fell, heavy with coin they had picked out of the old places.
The greasy sack lies empty where they fell.
Coins lie in the litter of their bedding, scraped together from the old dead.
Their bedding lies trampled, and no coin in it.
hoards: Coins lie scattered in the dust, green with age, where a purse rotted through.
Nothing is left in the dust but the shape of a purse.
A cracked pot lies on its side against the wall, and coins have spilled from it across the floor.
A cracked pot lies empty against the wall.
Coins glint in a crack between two flagstones, a row of them, pushed in edgeways long ago.
A crack between two flagstones is only a crack now.
A rotted pouch lies under a fallen stone, and coins have run out of it like seed.
A rotted pouch lies empty under a fallen stone.
Coins lie heaped in a niche in the wall, green and stuck together, left there as an offering.
A niche in the wall is empty but for a ring of green where coins lay.
A rusted coffer has burst at its seams, and coins lie in the rust around it.
A rusted coffer lies burst open and empty.
